records.description: Award of a call off contract under the Prison Education Dynamic Purchasing System for Railtrack provision for prisoners at HMP Guys Marsh. records.title: Learning, Talent and Performance Platform
records.description: Bromford Flagship LiveWest (BFL) wants to procure a single, modern Learning Management System (LMS) to provide a unified learning and compliance platform across the organisation. The proposed solution will replace existing learning platforms and support the delivery, management and reporting of learning across the organisation. The LMS will serve a workforce of more than 6,000 colleagues across a geographically dispersed operating area, supporting a wide range of roles including housing, property maintenance, customer services, corporate services, leadership and specialist functions. BFL requires a scalable, cloud-based solution capable of managing mandatory, role-specific, compliance, onboarding and professional development learning through a single platform. The system must support both internal colleagues and external users, including contractors, suppliers and customers. The proposed contract is anticipated to be for an initial term of 3 years, with the option to extend for up to a further 2 years. The contract value stated within this notice is an estimate over the initial 3 year contract term. For more information about this opportunity, please visit the eSourcing portal at: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/tenders/UK-UK-Tewkesbury:-Education-and-training-services./A8WA327ZQ7 To respond to this opportunity, please click here: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/respond/A8WA327ZQ7
